name: Soil Erosion, Sediment Transport & Landscape Recovery Runtime
design_rules: erosion increases with slope, runoff, bare soil and post-fire exposure
vegetation cover and root structure reduce soil loss
sediment moves downstream instead of disappearing
wetlands and floodplains capture more sediment than fast rivers
sediment deposition may raise turbidity and alter habitat quality
vegetation recovery progressively reduces erosion risk
erosion and deposition persist across world days
erosion never uses emissive or glow feedback
